name: Sol Next

author.name: Zhang Chongyang (许昌北海医院张重阳)

highlights: 2026 SOTA 24kHz on-device neural voice bundled inside APK: GTCRN denoiser + Silero VAD v5 + X-ASR 160ms streaming Zipformer2 Transducer (RTF 0.20) + Kokoro v1.1 24kHz HD bilingual TTS (103 voices, RTF 0.701, double-buffered prefetch, 3ms anti-pop fade, 4 curated voices with 1-tap preview)

Hand-written ARM64 NEON/DotProd/I8MM/SVE2 inline assembly (3.50x frameStats, 2.80x frameDiff, 4.80x resizeCrop, 1.82x q8Gemv, 6.04x cosineF32) + 3 spirv-val verified Vulkan 1.1 Compute Shaders + Android NNAPI NPU graph execution + QNN HTP / OpenCL probe in libsol_kernel.so v600

100% Full-Stack Rust 2024 architecture with zero Python across Android build toolchain (rust/sol-builder) and production backends (sol-world-rs at 16.7 MB RSS / 0.082ms p50, sol-engine-rs at 3.66 MB RSS / 1.76ms cold search)

Mature PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 cloud account system (phone/email + password, native Google Sign-In, Terms/Privacy dialogs, Account Center) — normal sign-in automatically unlocks free built-in DeepSeek and Brave Search

Android 13 zero-MotionEvent Accessibility IME passthrough (ACTION_SET_TEXT / ACTION_CLICK / ACTION_IME_ENTER) preventing virtual-display keyboard stealing, paired with Android 14-16 DISPLAY_IME_POLICY_HIDE

Mature product UX verified by 371/371 passing tests: 5-section Settings with live hardware benchmark, Drawer always-visible search, BYOK 1-tap connection probe, bottom-right collapsed PiP with zero reply occlusion, and 3-tab AI Phone Call Suite

faq.q: Does normal account sign-in include free built-in DeepSeek in Sol Next v9.3.1?
faq.a: Yes. v9.3.1 replaces legacy dummy OTP with a full PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 cloud account system and native Google Sign-In. Every signed-in account automatically activates free built-in DeepSeek and Brave Search.

faq.q: Does Sol Next v9.3.1 prevent the virtual display from stealing the keyboard on Android 13?
faq.a: Yes. On Android 13 (API 33) and below, Sol Next uses direct zero-MotionEvent Accessibility passthrough (ACTION_SET_TEXT / ACTION_CLICK / ACTION_IME_ENTER) so background virtual-display input never steals Display 0 IME focus; Android 14-16 also enforces DISPLAY_IME_POLICY_HIDE.

faq.q: Why is the v9.3.1 ARM64 APK 336 MB?
faq.a: v9.3.1 bundles 2026 SOTA X-ASR 160ms (161 MB) and Kokoro v1.1 24kHz HD 103-voice TTS (200 MB) uncompressed for zero-copy mmap instant startup with zero cloud voice fees.

faq.q: What native compute accelerators does libsol_kernel.so v600 support?
faq.a: Hand-written ARM64 NEON, DotProd (sdot), I8MM (smmla), and SVE2 inline assembly, plus Vulkan 1.1 Compute Shaders, Android NNAPI NPU graph execution, and Qualcomm QNN HTP / OpenCL detection, verifiable live via Settings > Hardware Benchmark.
